summary: Frontend-only retest of the CRITICAL mobile blocker from iteration_12 (ChatWidget overlay swallowing mobile SPIN taps). VERIFIED FIXED. On mobile 390x844 logged in as admin: ChatWidget collapsed state is now a 56x56 circular launcher (data-testid='chat-launcher-btn') at x318-374 / y692-748, clear of the sticky spin bar at y778-834. document.elementFromPoint at the SPIN centre returns the SPIN BUTTON itself on both flagship (/slots/golden_dynasty) and basic (/slots/mega_moolah) pages. REAL (non-forced, non-JS) Playwright taps succeeded on both: 1 POST /api/games/slots/spin each, balance 999,393 -> 999,293 (flagship) and 999,293 -> 999,193 (basic). Desktop 1440x900: flagship-spin-mobile and slot-spin-mobile are hidden (is_visible False) and in-panel flagship-spin / slot-spin-btn both fire a spin (999,193 -> 999,101, 999,101 -> 999,008). Keno regression OK: keno-live-board visible, auto-draws (content changes over 7s, shows 'LIVE KENO DRAW · #0001', 20 unique balls, 'DRAW COMPLETE', 'NEXT DRAW 01:59'), no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth == 390) on Keno and slot pages.

critical_code_review_comments: ChatWidget.jsx now correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and has data-testids (chat-launcher-btn / chat-panel / chat-input / chat-send-btn / chat-close-btn) — previous review comments resolved.

Z-index scale is still implicit: FlagshipSlot intro overlay and the mobile spin bar BOTH use z-[60] (FlagshipSlot.jsx L395 and L845). They don't currently conflict because the intro is dismissed by any tap, but the same numeric layer for a full-screen modal and a persistent action bar is fragile — consider documented tokens (e.g. --z-chat: 50, --z-action-bar: 60, --z-modal: 70).

rca_of_the_issue: Original defect: ChatWidget rendered a 320px-wide collapsed panel at fixed right-4/bottom-6 z-50 while the mobile sticky spin bars were z-40, so the widget received the pointer event. Fix confirmed effective on two fronts: (1) spin bars raised to z-[60] (FlagshipSlot.jsx L845, SlotGame.jsx L520), (2) collapsed ChatWidget reduced to a 56px circular launcher offset to bottom-24 on mobile (lg:bottom-6 desktop), removing the geometric overlap entirely. Both layers of the fix independently verified.
